references.title: 古代玻璃制品的成分分析与鉴别
references.evaluation_use: Contrast broad coverage of classification, correlation, discrimination and sensitivity only; no method, parameter, formula or result copied.

gap_summary: The first run covered all four questions and used composition-aware candidates, group-disjoint validation and quantitative perturbations.
The published analysis used a different valid portfolio; disagreement in model family is not treated as failure.
The frozen run could not promote its results because six generic downstream output fields were absent.
Weathering back-cast identifiability and sparse contingency inference remain explicit case-specific limitations.

references.title: Research on the Optimal Scheme of Raw Material Ordering and Transportation in Production Enterprises
references.publisher: Academic Journal of Computing & Information Science
references.evaluation_use: Contrast evaluation, temporal loss forecasting and constrained allocation coverage only; no method, parameter, formula or result copied.

gap_summary: Four non-baseline runs produced independently rechecked feasible multi-question plans; two baseline failures were preserved.
The published analysis confirms that ranking, loss dynamics and constrained allocation are legitimate coverage axes, but its specific portfolio is not an oracle.
The frozen comparison correctly blocked because the baseline had no success and post-selection test access was not authorized.
The generic downstream output contract needed a pre-run repair, independently repeating the same contract-discovery problem seen in the other cases.

references.title: 中小微企业的信贷决策
references.evaluation_use: Contrast risk prediction and loan amount/rate decision coverage only; no method, parameter, formula or result copied.

gap_summary: The first run passed all 14 stages with held-out post-selection risk metrics, explicit feasibility, scenario analysis, Claims and handoff.
The published analysis used a different predictor and decision construction; model-family disagreement is not treated as failure.
The first-run evidence is stronger on leakage-safe model comparison and independent post-selection testing than the bounded reference review can establish.
Two pre-run output/handoff contract recoveries show the same discoverability and timing defect that became terminal in the 2022 case.
